A letter of the application, or the CV: adapted to its offer when there is a
draft for it, else the CV page as it stands.

Contact.title: Contact

Someone at the company: third-party data, used to address a message, never put
in a prompt on its own.

line_no.title: Line No

DraftChoices.title: DraftChoices

OptionBlockers.title: OptionBlockers

Refused.title: Refused

ScoringRun.title: ScoringRun
ScoringRun.description:
What a batch of scorings did. It stops at the first failed call: the next one
would most likely fail the same way, and each one costs.

Everything that leaves, frozen at proposal. The sender's name is the identity's,
put in by code: this payload never reaches the model. `message_id` is generated
once, so a retry sends the same Message-ID.
